name: Mexico City
tagline: World-Class Culture at a Fraction of the Cost
description: Mexico City offers an unbeatable combination of cosmopolitan living, world-renowned cuisine, and affordable costs that make early retirement stretch remarkably far. With its thriving expat community, excellent healthcare infrastructure, and proximity to the US, CDMX has become one of the most popular FIRE destinations in the Americas.

quickFacts.visa: Temporary Resident Visa (1-4 years, renewable; requires proof of income ~$2,500/mo or savings ~$42,000)
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate — safe in expat-popular colonias like Roma, Condesa, Polanco
quickFacts.climate: Subtropical highland — mild year-round with rainy summers

housing.description: Modest studio or small apartment in a safe, non-prime colonia (Narvarte, Escandón, Del Valle, Portales, Coyoacán edge), lightly furnished

dining.description: Fondas, taquerías, and comida-corrida menus a few times a week; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: Voluntary enrollment in Mexico's IMSS public system, or a basic Mexico-only private major-medical plan (insurers like GNP, AXA, or MetLife) with a high deductible; priced for an early retiree aged 45-55.

transportation.description: Metro/Metrobús monthly pass plus the occasional Uber; no car

entertainment.description: Sunday-free museums, Chapultepec and parks, cantinas, free cultural programming

1M.lifestyle: A modest studio or small apartment in a safe, well-connected colonia like Narvarte, Escandón, or Del Valle — walkable, tree-lined, and a metro ride from anywhere. Most meals are cooked at home from Mercado Medellín produce, with taquerías and comida-corrida menus for eating out a few times a week. Transport is the Metro and Metrobús with the occasional Uber; no car. The city's free assets — Sunday-free museums, Chapultepec, cantina culture — do the entertaining. Frugal and careful, but genuinely rich in daily life, with basic private or IMSS cover handling routine care.

housing.description: Furnished apartment in a desirable central colonia (edge of Roma Norte/Condesa, Juárez, or solidly in Del Valle/Escandón)

dining.description: Out 3–4x/week mixing local fondas with Roma-Condesa mid-range tables

healthcare.description: Comprehensive Mexico-only private plan (GNP/AXA/MetLife) with access to ABC, Médica Sur, Ángeles

transportation.description: Metro/Metrobús plus regular Uber; still no car

entertainment.description: A full urban cultural and social calendar (museums, concerts, gym, nightlife)

2M.lifestyle: A furnished apartment on the edge of Roma Norte or Condesa, in Juárez, or solidly in Del Valle puts cafés, galleries, and nightlife on the doorstep. Dining out three or four nights a week across the city's celebrated casual-to-mid scene is routine, and comprehensive Mexican private insurance opens access to top hospitals like ABC and Médica Sur. Getting around is the Metro plus habitual Uber — still no car needed. A full cultural and social calendar of museums, concerts, and gym sessions rounds out an easy, unpretentious life.

housing.description: Quality furnished apartment in prime Roma Norte / Condesa / Juárez, or a generous layout in Polanco

dining.description: Dining out most days across the city's celebrated Roma-Condesa/Polanco scene

healthcare.description: Top-tier comprehensive Mexican private (low deductible, full ABC/Médica Sur/Ángeles access), approaching an entry international plan

transportation.description: Uber-heavy daily use plus occasional car rental; car ownership optional

entertainment.description: A rich cultural, dining, and travel calendar

3M.lifestyle: A quality furnished apartment in prime Roma Norte, Condesa, or Juárez — or a generous layout in Polanco — anchors a confident FIRE routine. Dining out is near-daily across the city's acclaimed restaurant scene, groceries lean on City Market and imported specialties, and premium Mexican private cover keeps out-of-pocket exposure low with full access to the best hospitals. Rideshare-first mobility handles the city, with weekend trips to San Miguel de Allende, Oaxaca, or the coast easily in budget. A rich calendar of theatre, fine dining, and cultural memberships comes with real margin to spare.

housing.description: Luxury apartment with amenities in a top-tier neighborhood (prime Polanco / Nuevo Polanco / prime Condesa), doorman building

dining.description: Near-daily dining including the city's top tables, with occasional destination fine dining

healthcare.description: Top-tier / entry-level international plan (Cigna Global, Allianz) with regional coverage

transportation.description: Owned car (fuel, parking, insurance, maintenance) plus premium rideshare

entertainment.description: A premium leisure, wellness, and travel routine

5M.lifestyle: A luxury apartment with amenities in Polanco or Nuevo Polanco — doorman building, rooftop, prime address — sets the tone, with a housekeeper coming two or three days a week. Dining spans casual to destination restaurants without a second thought, an entry-level international plan adds regional coverage, and a car plus premium rideshare covers the city. Discretionary spend flows into wellness, cultural memberships, and frequent getaways. Comfortably clear of what daily life in the capital requires, with the surplus going to travel and savings.

housing.description: Prime penthouse or large luxury apartment in Polanco / Lomas de Chapultepec / Nuevo Polanco — top of the long-term luxury stock

dining.description: Near-daily fine dining across the city's world-class scene (Pujol/Quintonil tier, Polanco tables)

healthcare.description: International concierge cover with medical evacuation to Houston/Miami (Cigna Global Platinum / Bupa Global tier)

transportation.description: Owned luxury car plus frequent private car service / premium rideshare

entertainment.description: Lavish entertaining, private events, premium memberships, frequent travel, wellness

domesticHelp.description: Full-time live-out household staff (housekeeper/cook and driver-caretaker)

luxuryExtras.description: Frequent international travel, art/wine, exclusive club memberships, luxury shopping

10M.lifestyle: A prime penthouse or large luxury apartment in Polanco, Nuevo Polanco, or Lomas de Chapultepec — the capital's most exclusive addresses — kept by full-time staff including a housekeeper-cook and driver. Fine dining is near-daily at the world-class tables that put this city on the global map, from Pujol to Quintonil, and international concierge cover with cross-border evacuation to Houston or Miami removes the last friction. A luxury vehicle with on-call driving, gourmet and imported provisioning, and a discretionary budget for constant travel, art, wine, and elite club memberships mean nothing is out of reach. This is the capital at its most opulent — a trophy address, resident staff, and a world-class city at the door.
